title: Consistent Naming: Blithe
description: A simple pack that renames Happy Ghasts, Ghastlings, and Dried Ghasts to Blithes, Blithelings, and Dried Blithes!
body: Happy Ghasts and Ghasts are two very different mobs, that merely share the same look. One is a fire proof and fire breathing menace, while the other is a joyful snow munching friend. Happy Ghasts aren't simple happy versions of the former, but completely different creatures. This pack acknowledges that difference and comes up with a more creative name, since Mojang couldn't be bothered to.
